zh: 我能试穿一下这条牛仔裤吗？
en: Can I {try on|try} these jeans?

zh: 你去那家新开的奥特莱斯逛过了吗？
en: Have you {checked out|been to|seen|visited|tried} that new outlet store yet?

zh: 演唱会门票十分钟就卖光了。
en: The concert tickets {sold out|sold|went} in ten minutes.

zh: 鞋子太小了，所以我拿去退了。
en: I {took back|returned|sent back|brought back} the shoes because they were too small.

zh: 买新手机之前，值得多逛几家比比价。
en: It's worth {shopping around|looking around} before you buy a new phone.

zh: 她给妈妈挑了一件很可爱的礼物。
en: She {picked out|chose|picked|found|bought|got|selected} a lovely present for her mum.

zh: 我在找一件防水夹克。
en: I'm {looking for|after|hunting for|shopping for} a waterproof jacket.

zh: 上周的日用品是谁付的钱？
en: Who {paid for|bought|got} the groceries last week?

zh: 这些小额消费一个月下来加起来真不少。
en: These small purchases really {add up|mount up} over a month.

zh: 您一共是四十五块。
en: Your total {comes to|is} forty-five dollars.

zh: 收银员录错了价格。
en: The cashier {rang up|charged|entered|put through|scanned|typed in|keyed in} the wrong price.

zh: 队排得太长，我就把巧克力放回去了。
en: I {put back|left|put down} the chocolate because the queue was too long.

zh: 夏天来之前我们囤了很多防晒霜。
en: We {stocked up on|loaded up on|bought} sunscreen before summer.

zh: 因为盒子破了，他们给便宜了百分之十。
en: They {knocked off|took off} ten percent because the box was damaged.

zh: 新靴子要穿几个星期才能磨合好。
en: It takes a few weeks to {break in|wear in} new boots.

zh: 这件衬衫配这条裤子吗？
en: Does this shirt {go with|match|work with} these trousers?

zh: 孩子们的校鞋已经穿不下了。
en: The kids have already {grown out of|outgrown} their school shoes.

zh: 我只是随便看看，谢谢。
en: I'm just {looking around|browsing|looking|having a look}, thanks.

zh: 上周末我们狠下心花大钱买了一张新沙发。
en: Last weekend we {splashed out on|splurged on} a new couch.

zh: 你能帮我留一双九码的吗？
en: Could you {put aside|set aside|hold|keep|save|put away|reserve} a pair in size nine for me?
